# FIELD Copilot Instructions

- Preserve the current UI structure, visual design, and product behavior.
- Do not introduce new features or change interaction flow unless explicitly requested.
- Keep changes focused on the task at hand.
- Prefer small, targeted edits over broad refactors.
- Do not add secrets, API keys, environment variables, or local-only configuration to the repository.
- Keep the project buildable and TypeScript-safe.
